confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Cebu and Visayas tourist-city price levels for July 2026. No live listings, menus, or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and beer anchors are the most reliable. Accommodation tiers are less certain because rates vary by district (IT Park, Lahug, Mactan, Mandaue) and season. Cocktail and wine are bounded from the beer anchor: cocktail is about 2.5x beer and wine glass about 4x beer, since direct knowledge of bar prices is weaker. Imported-wine markups are the main source of wine uncertainty.
comparable_city_reasoning: Basis is the Philippines regional and provincial urban price level (Cebu City and Visayas tourist centres), cross-checked against other mid-sized Southeast Asian destinations with similar hostel and budget-hotel supply. Price anchors were not sourced from web search.
